Name: Island Skeletons Furniture
Author: ImagineSandbox
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Creates furniture versions of the skeletons from the island Field Office. Ever wanted to have the big skeleton or the snake skeleton for your muesum?[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]You'll need to complete the Island Field Office and they will be avalible to purchase from the Island Trader the next day.[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download the mod, unzip the folder, and place the folder into your Mods Folder[/color][/size]

[b][size=4]Requirements[/size][/b]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Requires you to have unlocked the Island, The Island Trader, and have completed the Island Field office (or more specifically, to have the recipe for the Ostridge Incubator)[/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thank you SiTheGreat for making [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43811]"Modder's Pie - A Complete Tutorial For Your First Mod"[/url] which was a great first stepping stone to learning how to make mods of my own[/color]
